{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module EmailService where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base64 as B64
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Bits (xor)
import Data.Char (ord, chr, toLower)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf)

-- Encrypted storage key (simplified symmetric cipher)
storageKey :: BS.ByteString
storageKey = "k9X#mP2$vL7@nQ4&"

-- XOR-based stream cipher for storage encryption
encryptForStorage :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
encryptForStorage plaintext =
  let keyBytes = BS.cycle storageKey
      encrypted = BS.pack $ BS.zipWith xor plaintext (BS.take (BS.length plaintext) keyBytes)
  in B64.encode encrypted

decryptFromStorage :: BS.ByteString -> Either String BS.ByteString
decryptFromStorage ciphertext = do
  decoded <- B64.decode ciphertext
  let keyBytes = BS.cycle storageKey
      decrypted = BS.pack $ BS.zipWith xor decoded (BS.take (BS.length decoded) keyBytes)
  return decrypted

-- Header injection check: looks for CRLF sequences
-- Uses a normalized form to detect injection attempts
data SanitizeResult = Clean T.Text | Rejected String

-- Normalize text by handling encoded forms before checking
normalizeForCheck :: T.Text -> BS.ByteString
normalizeForCheck input =
  let -- Decode any percent-encoded sequences in the input
      decoded = percentDecode (TE.encodeUtf8 input)
      -- Convert to lowercase for consistent checking
      lowered = C8.map toLower decoded
  in lowered

percentDecode :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
percentDecode bs
  | BS.null bs = BS.empty
  | otherwise =
      let (before, after) = C8.break (== '%') bs
      in if BS.null after
         then before
         else if BS.length after >= 3
              then let hexPart = BS.take 2 (BS.drop 1 after)
                       rest = BS.drop 3 after
                       decoded = decodeHexByte hexPart
                   in case decoded of
                        Just b  -> before `BS.append` BS.singleton b `BS.append` percentDecode rest
                        Nothing -> before `BS.append` BS.singleton 0x25 `BS.append` percentDecode (BS.drop 1 after)
              else before `BS.append` after

decodeHexByte :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe Word8
decodeHexByte bs
  | BS.length bs /= 2 = Nothing
  | otherwise =
      let [h, l] = BS.unpack bs
          high = hexVal h
          low = hexVal l
      in case (high, low) of
           (Just hv, Just lv) -> Just (hv * 16 + lv)
           _ -> Nothing

hexVal :: Word8 -> Maybe Word8
hexVal w
  | w >= 0x30 && w <= 0x39 = Just (w - 0x30)
  | w >= 0x41 && w <= 0x46 = Just (w - 0x41 + 10)
  | w >= 0x61 && w <= 0x66 = Just (w - 0x61 + 10)
  | otherwise = Nothing

-- Check for CRLF injection in the NORMALIZED form
containsCRLF :: BS.ByteString -> Bool
containsCRLF bs = C8.isInfixOf "\r\n" bs

-- The sanitization pipeline
sanitizeEmailHeader :: T.Text -> SanitizeResult
sanitizeEmailHeader input =
  let normalized = normalizeForCheck input
  in if containsCRLF normalized
     then Rejected "CRLF injection detected"
     else Clean input  -- Returns ORIGINAL input, not normalized

-- Compose email with headers
data Email = Email
  { emailFrom    :: T.Text
  , emailTo      :: T.Text
  , emailSubject :: T.Text
  , emailBody    :: T.Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- Build raw email for sending via SMTP
buildRawEmail :: Email -> Either String BS.ByteString
buildRawEmail email = do
  from <- case sanitizeEmailHeader (emailFrom email) of
            Clean t -> Right t
            Rejected e -> Left e
  to <- case sanitizeEmailHeader (emailTo email) of
          Clean t -> Right t
          Rejected e -> Left e
  subject <- case sanitizeEmailHeader (emailSubject email) of
               Clean t -> Right t
               Rejected e -> Left e
  let rawEmail = T.concat
        [ "From: ", from, "\r\n"
        , "To: ", to, "\r\n"
        , "Subject: ", subject, "\r\n"
        , "MIME-Version: 1.0\r\n"
        , "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\n"
        , "\r\n"
        , emailBody email
        ]
  return $ TE.encodeUtf8 rawEmail

-- Store email in encrypted form and return for sending
processEmail :: Email -> Either String (BS.ByteString, BS.ByteString)
processEmail email = do
  raw <- buildRawEmail email
  let stored = encryptForStorage raw
  return (raw, stored)

-- UTF-8 encoding of certain sequences can bypass the check
-- because normalizeForCheck percent-decodes but the original
-- text passes through with overlong UTF-8 representations
-- that encode to CR/LF when the Text is encoded to ByteString
-- via a different path

-- Entry point for the service
handleSendRequest :: T.Text -> T.Text -> T.Text -> T.Text -> Either String (BS.ByteString, BS.ByteString)
handleSendRequest from to subject body =
  let email = Email from to subject body
  in processEmail email
